title: qubit-deja-vu: time-correlated mid-circuit readout errors on IBM Heron processors (run records and analysis code)
description:
Reset-free chains of up to 72 mid-circuit readouts per qubit on IBM Quantum's ibm_kingston and ibm_fez (15 and 16 October and 19 November 2026), screening for measurement errors correlated between consecutive readouts on the same qubit: leakage episodes, readout memory for equator and eigenstate inputs, and the difference between the first readout of a shot and readouts inside a chain. The archive holds every run's raw per-shot outcomes, manifests, submission records and machine-generated analysis reports, the pre-registered design and analysis code with its self-tests, and the results note. Designs and analysis code were committed before each run's data (PREREGISTRATION.md); analyses chosen after the data are labeled exploratory.

Independent work using a personal IBM Quantum account; no lab or institution has endorsed it. Data, notes and theory note: CC BY 4.0. Code in analysis/ and scripts/: MIT.
